name: codexfree
description: Electron desktop app and local Codex account proxy
author: BaoGuo

scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:node && bun run typecheck:web
scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun run daemon:bundle && bun electron-vite build
scripts.clean:packaged-apps: bun -e "const { rmSync } = require('node:fs'); for (const path of ['dist/mac', 'dist/mac-arm64', 'dist/win-unpacked', 'dist/win-arm64-unpacked', 'dist/linux-unpacked', 'dist/linux-arm64-unpacked']) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.build:unpack: bun run clean:packaged-apps && bun run build && bun electron-builder --dir -c.mac.identity=null
scripts.build:win: bun run clean:packaged-apps && bun run build && bun electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.build:mac: bun run clean:packaged-apps && bun run build && bun electron-builder --mac -c.mac.identity=null
scripts.build:linux: bun run clean:packaged-apps && bun run build && bun electron-builder --linux --dir
scripts.daemon: bun run daemon:bundle && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1 electron out/daemon/cli.cjs
